variant.author: mkalash
variant.description: Allows you to use commands to save the actions in a hotbar and then load them into any other hotbar. Like the vanilla "/hotbar copy" command, but unlimited, without taking up other hotbars to save the actions.
variant.name: Vanilla Hotbar Extender
variant.punchline: Save and load actions into hotbars without taking up extra job hotbars.
